data.title: Best Graphic Design Software for Print and Production Work (2026): CorelDRAW Recognized for Print-Friendly, Production-Ready Workflows by Better Business Advice

data.title: RiboX Therapeutics Announces FDA IND Clearance for RXIM002, the first Circular RNA-Based in vivo CAR Therapy for Autoimmune Cytopenias
data.description: Approval from the FDA for Investigational New Drug (IND) paves the way for RiboX to commence their Phase 1 clinical trial. This trial will assess RXIM002, an innovative circular RNA-based in vivo CAR-T therapy focusing on treating autoimmune cytopenias. Notably, RXIM002 is the first of its kind to gain FDA IND clearance, marking a significant milestone in the medical field.

data.title: World's First Long-Duration Energy Storage Integrated Industrial Park Commences Production Rollout: Shandong HiTHIUM Ushers in New Phase of Scalable Delivery
data.description: In Heze, China on August 8, 2026, Shandong HiTHIUM celebrated the Production Rollout Ceremony of the world's premier long-duration energy storage (LDES) integrated industrial park, known as Heze Base. The event took place in Heze Luxi New Area on August 7. This facility marks a significant milestone as the first of its kind globally, featuring advanced intelligent manufacturing capabilities.

data.title: AI model WeatherNext advances cyclone predictions by 1 day, a monumental leap in meteorology; open-source launch targets saving lives.
data.description: DeepMind's WeatherNext tool is extending cyclone warning time by an additional day, marking a significant advancement of ten years in meteorology. With an open-source release, the tool intends to enhance forecasting accuracy and potentially prevent loss of life during cyclones.

data.title: AMD's TLX improvements increase GEMM speed for LLM training, boosting GPU performance.
data.description: AMD has implemented TLX optimizations that are speeding up General Matrix Multiply (GEMM), reducing memory bottlenecks and improving training of large language models on GPUs. These optimizations have significantly increased performance, with users reporting up to a 30% boost in speed for training models like BERT and GPT-3. This advancement is particularly beneficial for deep learning tasks, where high computational power is required. The improved efficiency is making GPU-based training more accessible and efficient for developers working on complex language models.

data.description: Gemini Omni is revolutionizing creative workflows by allowing users to generate videos from text, images, and audio. This innovative approach is redefining the role of generative AI in content creation. This technology is set to transform the creative industry by providing a seamless and efficient way to produce engaging videos. With Gemini Omni, creators can access a new realm of possibilities as they craft multimedia content.

data.title: IMF predicts rise in demand for USD-backed stablecoins due to liquidity and cross-border usability. Dan Katz comments.

The statement underscores the potential popularity of digital currencies, reflecting a growing trend in the financial sector.

data.title: Bybit Sues North Korea and Lazarus Group, Secures Preliminary Injunction Freezing Stolen Assets in Landmark Crypto Asset Recovery Effort
data.description: A recent lawsuit has been filed alleging North Korea and the Lazarus Group of masterminding a substantial $1.5 billion theft.
